_comment: Schema deployment rules. 7 JSON-LD schema types across the site, with per-type placement and validation rules.

rules: 3-5 questions per page maximum (more gets ignored by parser)
Questions must match real Google autocomplete suggestions
Every answer must start with a number
Answers: 50-90 words with at least one concrete data point
One FAQPage schema per page — duplicates trigger suppression of ALL rich results
schemaTypes.critical: Never stack CMS-injected FAQPage on top of manual one. Duplicate FAQPage schemas trigger Google penalty.

schemaTypes.benefit: Google Dataset Search traffic — an underused channel
rules: Include temporalCoverage (e.g. '2020/2026')
Include variableMeasured (what data the page contains)
Include name and description
Apply to every data-heavy page, tool, or dashboard

schemaTypes.where: All blog posts and editorial content
rules: Include author as Person entity with sameAs links (Twitter, LinkedIn)
Include datePublished and dateModified
Headline under 110 characters (Google truncates after that)
Include publisher as Organization
Include name, url, logo, sameAs (all social profiles)
Only one per site — place in root layout
Include name, url, potentialAction (SearchAction)
Only one per site — place in root layout
Match actual site navigation hierarchy
Include itemListElement with position, name, and item (URL)

schemaTypes.where: Category pages, archive pages, tag pages
rules: Include name and description
Link to contained items via hasPart or mainEntity

duplicateDetection.note: FAQPage duplicates = penalty. Other type duplicates = warning.
